title: most cuts don't fail because of the diet. they fail because nobody could keep it up.

most cuts don't fail because of the diet. they fail because nobody could keep it up.

go slow on purpose, get your protein in, keep lifting, keep the food you love, and decide when the cut ends before you start. boring, but it's what lets you actually finish.
